metadata.description: Cong thuc hinh hoc khong gian va toa do khong gian lop 12

formulas.name: plane_general_equation
formulas.name_vi: Phuong trinh tong quat mat phang
formulas.description_vi: Phuong trinh tong quat cua mat phang voi vecto phap tuyen n = (A, B, C)
formulas.description_en: General equation of plane with normal vector n = (A, B, C)

formulas.name: plane_intercept_form
formulas.name_vi: Phuong trinh mat phang dang doan chan
formulas.description_vi: Mat phang cat cac truc toa do tai A(a,0,0), B(0,b,0), C(0,0,c)
formulas.description_en: Intercept form: plane intersects axes at (a,0,0), (0,b,0), (0,0,c)

formulas.name: plane_through_point_normal
formulas.name_vi: Mat phang qua diem voi vecto phap tuyen
formulas.description_vi: Mat phang qua M(x0, y0, z0) voi vecto phap tuyen n = (A, B, C)
formulas.description_en: Plane through point M with normal vector n
examples: Mat phang qua M(1,2,3) voi n=(1,1,1): x-1+y-2+z-3=0

formulas.name: line_parametric_equation
formulas.name_vi: Phuong trinh tham so duong thang
formulas.formula: x = x0 + at, y = y0 + bt, z = z0 + ct
formulas.description_vi: Duong thang qua M(x0,y0,z0) voi vecto chi phuong u = (a,b,c)
formulas.description_en: Parametric equation of line through M with direction vector u

formulas.name: line_canonical_equation
formulas.name_vi: Phuong trinh chinh tac duong thang
formulas.description_vi: Phuong trinh chinh tac duong thang qua M voi VTCP u = (a,b,c)
formulas.description_en: Canonical equation of line

formulas.name: distance_point_to_plane
formulas.name_vi: Khoang cach tu diem den mat phang
formulas.formula: d = |Ax0 + By0 + Cz0 + D| / sqrt(A^2 + B^2 + C^2)
formulas.description_vi: Khoang cach tu diem M(x0,y0,z0) den mat phang Ax+By+Cz+D=0
formulas.description_en: Distance from point to plane

formulas.name: distance_point_to_line
formulas.name_vi: Khoang cach tu diem den duong thang
formulas.description_vi: Khoang cach tu diem M den duong thang d, A thuoc d, u la VTCP
formulas.description_en: Distance from point to line using cross product

formulas.name: distance_parallel_planes
formulas.name_vi: Khoang cach hai mat phang song song
formulas.description_vi: Khoang cach giua hai mat phang song song Ax+By+Cz+D1=0 va Ax+By+Cz+D2=0
formulas.description_en: Distance between parallel planes

formulas.name: distance_skew_lines
formulas.name_vi: Khoang cach hai duong thang cheo nhau
formulas.description_vi: Khoang cach giua hai duong cheo nhau dung tich hon tap
formulas.description_en: Distance between skew lines using scalar triple product
examples: [AB, u1, u2] la tich hon tap cua AB, u1, u2

formulas.name: angle_two_planes
formulas.name_vi: Goc giua hai mat phang
formulas.description_vi: Goc giua hai mat phang tinh qua tich vo huong cac vecto phap tuyen
formulas.description_en: Angle between two planes using normal vectors

formulas.name: angle_line_plane
formulas.name_vi: Goc giua duong thang va mat phang
formulas.description_vi: Goc giua duong thang (VTCP u) va mat phang (VTPT n)
formulas.description_en: Angle between line and plane

formulas.name: angle_two_lines
formulas.name_vi: Goc giua hai duong thang
formulas.description_vi: Goc giua hai duong thang tinh qua tich vo huong cac VTCP
formulas.description_en: Angle between two lines using direction vectors

formulas.name: volume_tetrahedron
formulas.name_vi: The tich tu dien
formulas.description_vi: The tich tu dien ABCD bang 1/6 gia tri tuyet doi tich hon tap
formulas.description_en: Volume of tetrahedron using scalar triple product

formulas.name: volume_prism
formulas.name_vi: The tich lang tru
formulas.description_vi: The tich lang tru bang dien tich day nhan chieu cao
formulas.description_en: Volume of prism = base area × height
examples: Lang tru tam giac deu canh a, chieu cao h: V = (a^2*sqrt(3)/4)*h

formulas.name: volume_pyramid
formulas.name_vi: The tich hinh chop
formulas.description_vi: The tich hinh chop bang 1/3 dien tich day nhan chieu cao
formulas.description_en: Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × base area × height
examples: Chop tu giac deu canh a, chieu cao h: V = (1/3)*a^2*h

formulas.name: volume_cylinder
formulas.name_vi: The tich hinh tru
formulas.description_vi: The tich hinh tru tron bang pi nhan binh phuong ban kinh nhan chieu cao
formulas.description_en: Volume of cylinder = πr²h

formulas.name: volume_cone
formulas.name_vi: The tich hinh non
formulas.description_vi: The tich hinh non bang 1/3 pi nhan binh phuong ban kinh nhan chieu cao
formulas.description_en: Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

formulas.name: volume_sphere
formulas.name_vi: The tich hinh cau
formulas.description_vi: The tich hinh cau bang 4/3 pi nhan lap phuong ban kinh
formulas.description_en: Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

formulas.name: cross_product
formulas.name_vi: Tich co huong (tich vecto)
formulas.description_vi: Tich co huong cua hai vecto trong khong gian
formulas.description_en: Cross product of two vectors

formulas.name: dot_product
formulas.name_vi: Tich vo huong
formulas.description_vi: Tich vo huong cua hai vecto
formulas.description_en: Dot product of two vectors

formulas.name: parallel_condition_lines
formulas.name_vi: Dieu kien song song hai duong thang
formulas.formula: u1 = k * u2 (u1 cung phuong u2)
formulas.description_vi: Hai duong thang song song khi VTCP cung phuong
formulas.description_en: Two lines parallel when direction vectors are parallel

formulas.name: perpendicular_condition_lines
formulas.name_vi: Dieu kien vuong goc hai duong thang
formulas.description_vi: Hai duong thang vuong goc khi tich vo huong VTCP bang 0
formulas.description_en: Two lines perpendicular when dot product of direction vectors is 0
